issue_context.title: REF: Define ops on Resampler as normal methods
issue_context.body:
Ref: https://github.com/pandas-dev/pandas/pull/48980#pullrequestreview-1134863343

Similar to #48400 with groupby, we should define methods on the `Resampler` class rather than setting them as attributes after the class definition. While this involves a little more boilerplate code, it is more straightforward to understand and easier to enhance or extend.
comments: Is this issue still possible do Take?
@Pvlb1998 - yes, comment `take` and it will be assigned to you.
hello, could you specify a little better the purpose of the issue? in which file is this class found? Is there any solution suggestion?

review_comments: For these one that were left out, I couldn't inherit since the associated groupby doc contains numba arguments that are not supported by resample.
looks like args/kwargs are getting ignored for many of these.  can we just remove them?
I think that would require a deprecation cycle like what was done in https://github.com/pandas-dev/pandas/pull/50338, but I would be +1 for deprecating *args, **kwargs here
